description_en: Queries the details of a specified prefix list, including the name, address family, maximum number of entries, and entry details
description_zh: 查询指定前缀列表的详细信息，包含前缀列表的名称、地址族、最大条目容量以及条目的详细信息等
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-prefix-list-attributes --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --prefix-list-id pl-x1j1k5ykzqlixdcy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrefixListAttributes

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

AddressFamily.description_en:
The address family of the prefix list. Valid values:

IPv4.
IPv6
AddressFamily.description_zh:
前缀列表的地址族。可能值：

IPv4。
IPv6

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the prefix list was created. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 前缀列表的创建时间。格式为 ISO 8601，时区为 UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the prefix list

Entry.description_en: The entries in the prefix list
Entry.description_zh: 前缀列表中的条目信息组成的数组

Cidr.description_en: The Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block of the prefix list entry
Cidr.description_zh: 前缀列表条目的CIDR地址块信息

Description.description_en: The description of the prefix list entry
Description.description_zh: 前缀列表条目的描述信息

MaxEntries.description_en: The maximum number of entries that the prefix list supports
MaxEntries.description_zh: 前缀列表支持的最大条目容量

PrefixListName.description_en: The name of the prefix list
